commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alex Baena (Villarreal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes a short corner kick.
90' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
89' Alex Baena (Villarreal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
89' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
89' Alex Baena (Villarreal) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
88' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is cleared to safety by the defence.
88' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Villarreal.

87' What a chance that is! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
85' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Denis Suarez (Villarreal) is coming onto the pitch as Pape Gueye cannot continue after picking up an injury.

83' A wild pass somehow finds Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
83' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Federico Valverde and he is replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
82' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Jesus Manzano stops the game and makes a call. Real Madrid have a free kick.
79' Substitution. Santi Comesana did his best and is replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
79' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
75' The referee shows the yellow card to Juan Foyth (Villarreal).
74' The attendance is 20559.
73' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
72' Flag up against Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
70' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
68' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
68' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
66' Surely that's handball by one of the Villarreal players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
66' Thibaut Courtois pulls off a good save to deny a long-range header from Alex Baena (Villarreal). Great goalkeeping!
65' Here comes a substitution. Rodrygo is given a rest as he is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
64' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Tajon Buchanan will be replaced by Yeremy Pino (Villarreal).
64' Substitution. Sergi Cardona will be replaced by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).

64' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
63' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends the corner into the box, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts it and averts the threat.
63' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Villarreal earn a corner.
61' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) replaces Brahim Diaz.
61' Raul Asencio will be replaced by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid).
59' Great touch by Alex Baena (Villarreal) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
56' Jesus Manzano blows for a foul after Juan Foyth (Villarreal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick is awarded to Real Madrid.
55' Alex Baena (Villarreal) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

54' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
53' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
50' The foul by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jesus Manzano.

49' Great pass, great header, but no goal! Alex Baena picked out Thierno Barry (Villarreal) on the penalty spot with a lofted pass and his bullet header was just inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
48' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
48' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Marcelino has made a change at the break. Thierno Barry (Villarreal) has come on in place of Nicolas Pepe.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+3' Alex Baena (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
45+1' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' A neat pass is well received by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.

44' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Diego Conde pulls off an easy save.
42' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
41' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sprays a pass out to Rodrygo, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
38' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle. Real Madrid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
37' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
33' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
31' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle as Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. A free kick to Real Madrid.
30' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
29' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
27' The current number of shots on goal is 5:3.
27' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle. Alex Baena (Villarreal) commits a foul after dangerous play. Real Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
25' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
23' 1 - 2 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
22' The resulting corner from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) comes to nothing.
22' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
21' Alex Baena (Villarreal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
21' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Villarreal in a dangerous position.
18' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
17' 1 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
17' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Diego Conde.
15' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) attempts to feed Kylian Mbappe with a chip pass, but Diego Conde reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
14' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
14' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.

13' That's unlucky! Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Now Real Madrid have a corner.
12' The resulting corner from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
12' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Villarreal get a corner.
12' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

10' That was close by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Juan Foyth (Villarreal) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
7' Alex Baena (Villarreal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

7' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. Villarreal have a corner.
5' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

5' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Thibaut Courtois shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
4' Rough tackle by Pape Gueye (Villarreal). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Madrid.
